benefits.name: No cost for upskilling yourself
benefits.details: As an upGrad employee, you get special benefits with up to 100% fee waiver on any of the upGrad's programs

benefits.name: Referral benefits
benefits.details: Get the best of both worlds. Earn handsome referral benefits for both employee referral as well as learner referral

benefits.name: Your career, your move
benefits.details: Come for a job in the learning experience team, transition into a marketing role if you like it more. We support all your career moves

benefits.name: You become the owners
benefits.details: We believe in creating a culture of shared ownership. Employees from entry-level to leadership have ESOPs and are proud owners of upGrad

benefits.name: With you throughout
benefits.details: Your physical, mental and emotional wellbeing is our utmost priority. Doctors and expert counsellors are available 24x7 free of cost for all the consultation and support you need

benefits.name: Our door is always open for you
benefits.details: Our culture embedded with integrity and transparency will give you direct access with the leaders, managers and cross-functional colleagues where you can share your views, ideas and feedback openly
